chnnchh wh dwnwN phr rwnh hwgy'y, yhN tkh khh jb ykh bsty wlwN khy ps phnchy tw s khy bshndwN sy khhn mng tw n lwgwN ny n khy mhmny khrny sy nkhr khrdy. phr nhyN whN ykh dywr mly jw gr hy chhty thy, n SHb ny sy khhrr khrdy. mwsy ny khh: gr ap chhty tw s khm pr khchh jrt ly lyty. [1]

chnnchh hm ny yh chh khh n kh prwrdgr nhyN s lrrkhy khy bdly ysy wld dy jw pkhyzgy myN bhy s sy bhtr hw, wr Hsn slwkh myN bhy s sy brrhy hwy'y hw.

yhN tkh khh jb wh dw phrrwN khy drmyn phnchy tw nhyN n phrrwN sy phly khchh lwg mly jn khy bry myN ys lgt th khh wh khwy'y bt nhyN smjhty. [1]

chnnchh jb wh n sy wr n (btwN) sy lg hwgy'y jnhyN wh llh khy bjy'y pkhr khrty thy, tw hm ny nhyN sHq wr y`qwb (jysy wld) bkhshy, wr n myN sy hr ykh khw nby bny.

yh sb GlT bt hy! wh tw n khy `bdt hy kh nkhr khrdyN gy, wr ltty n khy mkhlf hwjy'yN gy.

chnnchh (y pyGmbr) hm ny s qran khw tmhry zbn myN asn bndy hy tkhh tm s khy dhry`y mtqy lwgwN khw khwshkhbrdy dw, wr sy khy dhry`y n lwgwN khw ddrw' jw Dd khy wjh sy jhgrry pr amdh hyN.
n sy phly hm khtny hy qwmwN khw hlkh khrchkhy hyN. khy tmhyN ttttwlny sy bhy n myN sy khsy kh pth mlt hy, y n myN sy khsy khy bhnkh bhy tmhyN sny'y dyty hy?

[2] wr myN ny pny Trf sy tm pr ykh mHbwbyt nzl khrdy thy. [3] wr yh sb s lyy khy th khh tm myry ngrny myN prwrsh pw'. [4]

Hqyqt yh hy khh jw shkhS pny prwrdgr khy ps mjrm bn khr ay'y g, s khy lyy jhnm hy js myN nh wh mry g wr nh jy'y g. [1]
